pattern: Read-heavy, point lookups by user id, flexible fields
rationale: Riders and drivers have different, changing attributes; one JSON document per user is read in a single lookup.

pattern: Write-heavy, append-only, range scans by user + time
rationale: Partition by user, cluster by ride time: fast appends and 'last N rides' range scans at huge scale.

pattern: Very high write rate, latest value only, short-lived
rationale: driver_id -> current location in memory, with geo commands and expiry; sub-millisecond reads for matching.
Multi-document transactions keep fare, wallet and ride status correct together.
A post with its media and tags is naturally one document and can be indexed by hashtag or author.
'Friends of friends' and influencer paths are cheap edge traversals instead of repeated joins.
Billions of events per day, partitioned by post and time for fast writes and time-range reads.

pattern: Large binary blobs, write once read many
rationale: Images and videos fetched whole by key; cheap and durable.
